headlines.text: Rewind to 2021, when The Young Bucks vs. The Varsity Blonds went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.57. For The Varsity Blonds, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Looking back to 2023, when Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta vs. Best Friends & Bandido crossed paths for the first time ever, setting the tone as the night's opener on Rampage, rated 6.80.

Turning the clock back to 2021: the NWA World Women's Title was up for grabs as Serena Deeb vs. Red Velvet went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.05 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. It was the first title opportunity of Red Velvet's career. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2021, when Christian Cage vs. Matt Sydal met for the very first time, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 6.57.
2023 brought us this moment: it was a long-awaited, welcome sight as Bishop Kaun returned to the ring after just over 6 months away, appearing on Rampage.
2021 brought us this moment: it marked the first-ever meeting between Kingston & Moxley and The Acclaimed on Dynamite, rated 6.20.
